decision: Run the sigma pilot only on the bound frozen contract; refuse unless BINDING.json status == BOUND; order never reversed
Estimand is SD(Delta R2_genetic) per (regime,k) cell; the pilot estimates variance only and never declares a winner
Because R2_genetic fits the noise-free genetic value g the primary replicate SD is heritability-independent; the pilot uses no h2 grid
Use three representative regimes spectral_tail_adversarial major_LD_aligned between_block_interaction at per-block k in {8,16} with R_pilot=30 and 5-fold CV
R_formal = max over primary-relevant cells of the required R never the average; size to the hardest regime
If no candidate R suffices increase R never lower the 0.005 margin
src/gate0a is the reference implementation of Gate 0A arms DGP metric and bilinear head; Gate 0A reuses it
Pilot results may only decide replicate count and compute feasibility; not margin DGP retention k arm success threshold or which regime is primary
Run on the donor-train (2247) only; the 249 donor-validation rows are never touched by the pilot
Draw the outer 5-fold split once and share it byte-identically across all regimes budgets arms and replicates
A replicate is one fixed genetic value g drawn once and predicted across all outer folds; g never changes per fold
Penalty selection is a real nested inner 5-fold CV not a single 80/20 split
Each regime g = sqrt(1-frac)*named + sqrt(frac)*diffuse_polygenic with frac=0.5 matching the rc2 DGP
Cache arm representations once per (arm,fold,block) at k=16 and slice for k=8; reuse across replicates and regimes
Require EXPORT_MANIFEST.json tying the exported arrays to the BOUND panel/block SHA and counts; run refuses without provenance match
Exclude mutable BINDING.json from MANIFEST.sha256 so binding does not invalidate the frozen-design manifest
